focus: Canonicalize the actor-sprite payload buffer passed from the AnimationVM pass into the VDP submission path.
contracts: AnimationVM_RunActorPass initializes its A3 output cursor from 0x00FF769A before processing actor animation frames.
Render_BuildActorSpritePayload emits one 14-byte payload record per expanded frame and increments the low byte of 0x00FFEFEE.
Render_SubmitActorSprites reads 0x00FF769A and streams the payload records counted by ACTOR_SPRITE_PAYLOAD_COUNT to VDP.
conclusion: The anonymous work-RAM region at 0x00FF769A is the actor-sprite payload buffer shared by the AnimationVM renderer producer and VDP submission consumer.
